speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The jug is in my other hand, so you will answer before I set it down. Is the king still dying.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He died on Friday, Mistress. In the second act. I have shut that act. Yesterday I began the third, half a sheet, and I am not telling it here.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is it the same king, sir. The one you walked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same. The second act is shut. The third was begun yesterday. I am not telling it at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then he is dead at this table, and yesterday's sheet can keep the next trouble. That is a mercy, if you mean to keep it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A shut act is a clean board. I like a clean board. I do not ask what you will write on it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. I will ask. Not tonight. The loaf first. It is a penny, and it is a finger and a half short of the notch. It is not going on any pan.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny. A finger and a half. I will tell her that, and nothing cleverer.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Three pence if you sit, sir. I heard her say it to the pot.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Three pence, and the three pence stays in the pot when you do not sit. You are sitting. Pay it after, not over the bread.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have paid mine. The bread is smaller than last month. I do not make a speech of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. The house eats. I am well. That is the letter, if I can keep it so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not spend a clean sheet telling her why a play is a trade. She has heard a trade. She has not asked for a sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. I have no defence to send. The children are as I last heard, and I have no newer word of one than of another.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: That is fair, sir. A house asks after all of them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: As I am a Christian woman, answer her in the order she asked, and stop when the order stops. Leave the foot of the sheet for the one thing that needs her yes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The barn. Whether the Sadlers' cousin still means to build it this summer. I will leave the line.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A barn is a yes or a no. A play is neither. You are right to leave the barn to her.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the sleeve, if you must send a story. Send the woman with the needle, not the man who tore it. She will know which part matters.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The seamstress. She made him do the gesture again, slowly. I will send her hands, not his glory.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Hands are the true part, sir. I have mended a cuff. The gesture is the dear bit.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat. Yesterday's sheet can wait until you have chewed. I am not ruling on a king I have not been told.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not telling him tonight. The second act is shut. That is the news at this table.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then I will take the news, and the bread, and I will not ask for the third.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three pence. I have it. I am not putting the loaf on a pan to make the notch kinder.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The notch is the notch, sir. I cut what she gives me.
